finding: Exterior stage resume CHECK required the new current generation/epoch reserve marker before the same preparation could create that marker. A settled WAIT leg with an original matching native-motion receipt could therefore be dropped during owner reconstruction. Stage/movement maps were also populated before final marker commit, even if that commit refused.
implementation: Validated unchanged stage journal may supply one temporary private [visitContext,actor,target] proposal to BuildingActorMotion CHECK. Only original MOVE receipt of that actor/group/visit/target plus actual native MOVE or settled WAIT, endpoint/rest/floor and all operation/route/owner/eligibility checks can pass.

The private proposal is CHECK-only; it cannot authorize MOVE/HOLD publication or ADOPT/settings/commands. It is removed immediately after synchronous CHECK, before any marker commit. Stage journal must still equal the captured snapshot and contain at most64 rows.

Both staged and final preparation WAIT checks use this wrapper. Final live native/owner check establishes the new local reserve marker. Only an actual successful marker commit retains stage/movement maps; refusal does not occupy a new security slot. Historical known-casualty post evidence remains separate.
cost: No scan, geometry ray, worker, timer or command. At most2 scoped checks per resumed settled exterior row, within the existing64-row loop. Each compares the captured phase journal (up to64 rows) and invokes existing native/context checks; this comparison/check cost is unmeasured. Ordinary active work has only the additional constant-size private CHECK proposal lookup.

validation.development: Build1 failed an existing test that expected direct CHECK spelling; updated to verify the scoped wrapper and retained exact native CHECK. Build2 passed, then final review made role bookkeeping conditional on successful marker commit.

limitations: This consumes a validated separately delivered phase journal, not a coherent authenticated full producer checkpoint. Missing/delayed journal distinctions, aggregate actor readiness and actual external/old-owner quiescence remain incomplete.
No receipt is fabricated for an unrecorded/unknown old move; changed native task/target and missing proof still refuse. Same-value new native orders remain observationally ambiguous.
No physical isolation/straggler/migration result or5%median/10%p95 overhead acceptance; normal and actual-provider HC audits remain paused.
